BrochureContent.Content:
The accommodation extends to approximately 294 square metres (3,164 square feet) of beautifully appointed living space. At its heart is the vast living, kitchen and dining space, which opens, through full height, double sliding doors, to the south west facing suntrap patio and garden, merging indoor and outdoor life with ease. A spacious entrance hall, formal living room, TV family room, a generous shower room, utility room and integrated garage complete the ground floor. On the first floor there are four large double bedrooms, master en-suite, and a family bathroom. All bedrooms are fitted with built-in wardrobes. In addition there are stairs to a beautifully appointed, bright, spacious attic room with an ensuite shower room. The south west facing garden is laid out with low maintenance lawn, specimen planting and terraces. Part walled and part-fenced the garden has beautiful tranquil spaces which provide a private haven for relaxation and entertaining. Outside lighting, water-tap and electrical points are in place. 

The property includes excellent off-street gated car parking for 3 cars to the front. Situated on St. John`s Park, No.6 enjoys an unrivalled location being moments from Monkstown`s and Dun Laoghaire`s coastal walks. The nearby beaches at Seapoint and Sandycove are perfect for sea swimmers and leisurely strolls along the seafront, while the popular Monkstown Crescent offers a range of specialty food stores, fashion boutiques, and a selection of dining options, such as Bresson, FX Buckley`s, Avoca and Cafe du Journal. The town of Dun Laoghaire is just a short distance away, including two shopping centres, supermarkets, banks, and a multi-screen cinema, the Pavillion Theatre, Lexicon library as well as four sailing clubs. Tennis enthusiasts will appreciate nearby clubs. The property benefits from excellent transport links, with easy access to the city centre, DART services, bus routes, and the Aircoach to Dublin Airport. 

There are outstanding marine facilities along the seafront. In terms of recreational amenities, the new owner will be spoilt for choice with a range of tennis clubs including Monkstown and De Vesci and a wide array of football, rugby and GAA clubs also close by. There is a superb choice of primary and secondary schools in the area, among them CBC Monkstown, Rathdown, Cluny, Holy Child, Blackrock College, Willow Park, St. Andrews, Loreto Foxrock, Loreto Dalkey, Scoil Lorcáin, Hollypark and Lycée Français d`Irlande. 

Outside

Beautiful landscaped garden to the rear. Extensive paved Patio area with steps down to a wonderful mature garden. Measuring c.50m x 13m, part walled and part fenced with mature lawn, fruit trees, shrubs and planting. The property backs on to Monkstown Lawn Tennis Club.

To the front, there is off street parking for 3 cars, a hidden bin area and a garage to the side.

A stunning property, oozing comfort and charm and superbly located close to all amenities. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.
